detail.note: the founder's rule that 360 inspection must not alter permanent framing

tests.name: the opening view is the close-up the founder specified

detail.note: front is the canonical opening view and is held to the contract. The recurrence this guards rendered the mascot at 41.5% while every proof of the day passed; a 65 floor would have passed it at 66.

tests.name: rotated views stay inside the close-up envelope and stay centred

detail.note: a silhouette legitimately changes with angle, so this is an envelope rather than the front's band -- but thumbnail scale, clipping and drift off centre fail at every angle.

tests.name: what the solve predicts and what the pixels show agree

detail.note: pixels may EXCEED the prediction -- auras and fire reach past the body by design -- but falling short of it means the camera is framing something other than what is being drawn.
